gradeScale: Letter grades from S down to F; separate grades for Tone and Technical performance; value stars up to 3 stars.

entries.name: Sennheiser HE 1 Orpheus 2
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it S (tone S+, technicalities S) with a harman neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $59000).
entries.quote: Mostly neutral, slight bass lift, highly resolving and natural both in tone and timbre. The world's best headphone.

entries.name: Hifiman Susvara
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it S (tone S, technicalities S, ★ value) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $6000).
entries.quote: Subtle refinements to the already-great HE1000 makes this arguably the best planar in the world.

entries.name: HIFIMAN HE1000 V2
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it S- (tone S, technicalities S-) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $3000 (HE1000)).
entries.quote: A planar that comes unnervingly close estat speed, but not quite. Solid technicalities with excellent tone.

entries.name: Focal Utopia
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it S- (tone S, technicalities S-, ★ value) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $4000).
entries.quote: Solid tuning with close to top-tier resolution. An inoffensive all-rounder that lives up to its reputation.

entries.name: Focal Clear
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it A+ (tone S-, technicalities A+) with a warm neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $Discontinued 1500 (Replaced by Clear Mg)).
entries.quote: A decent Utopia alternative for thinner wallets. Slightly warmer sound may be more pleasant for some.

entries.name: HIFIMAN HE1000se
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it A+ (tone A+, technicalities S-) with a bright neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $3500).
entries.quote: Basically a brighter and slightly shoutier version of the OG; may be a little too intense for some.

entries.name: HIFIMAN Arya
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it A+ (tone A+, technicalities S-, ★ value) with a bright neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $1600).
entries.quote: High resolution planar that may be a little peaky in the treble for some.

entries.name: Hifiman Shangri La Jr
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it A+ (tone A, technicalities S) with a bright neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $8000).
entries.quote: A tad too shouty for my tastes, but far less offensive tonal characteristics than the average estat.

entries.name: HIFIMAN Jade II
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it A (tone A, technicalities S-) with a bass-rolled neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $2500).
entries.quote: Suffers from typical estat timbre and bass extension issues, but otherwise a very resolving and well-tuned headphone.

entries.name: Stax SR-007
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it A (tone A-, technicalities S+) with a warm neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $2100+975 (SRM-353X)).
entries.quote: Arguably the least wonky-sounding of the mainstream Staxes, with resolution just shy of the flagship 009.

entries.name: HEDD Audio HEDDphone D1
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it A (tone A, technicalities A+, ★ value) with a warm neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $1900).
entries.quote: An interesting in-between of DD and estat timbre, though tuning around the lower midrange may be off.

entries.name: Aurorus Borealis
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it A (tone A+, technicalities A, ★★ value) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $900).
entries.quote: Sounds like an odd mashup of the HD600 and the Clear, in a good way.

entries.name: Nectar Hive
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it A (tone A, technicalities A, ★ value) with a bright neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $600+975 (SRM-353X)).
entries.quote: Some spiciness in the treble that is HD800-esque, but with a better midrange presentation.

entries.name: HIFIMAN Edition X V2
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it A- (tone S, technicalities B+) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $1300 (Edition X V2)).
entries.quote: Excellent tonal balance though limited by blunted notes and resolution.

entries.name: Stax SR-Lambda Pro
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it A- (tone B+, technicalities S-) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $700 (SR-Lambda Pro)).
entries.quote: One of the original Lambda models, and arguably the best tuned of the Lambda-styled Staxes.

entries.name: Sennheiser HD 600
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it A- (tone S-, technicalities B+, ★★ value) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $400).
entries.quote: The legendary neutral reference. Slightly better clarity and imaging than the HD650.

entries.name: Audio-Technica ATH-R70x
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it A- (tone A+, technicalities B+, ★★ value) with a warm neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $350).
entries.quote: Excellent imaging. Mostly neutral/flat tuning with an ever-so-slight tilt towards warmth.

entries.name: Stax SR-404
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B+ (tone B, technicalities S-) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $500 (SR-404)).
entries.quote: Similar tuning to that of the Lambda Pro. Sonically identical between 404 and 404LE.

entries.name: Stax SR-507
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B+ (tone B, technicalities S-) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $830 (SR-507)).
entries.quote: Similar tuning to that of the Lambda Pro.

entries.name: HIFIMAN HE6
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B+ (tone B, technicalities S-) with a bright neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $1300 (HE6)).
entries.quote: Clean, resolving yet intense sound scratches the detail itch but is a little too edgy for long listens.

entries.name: Stax SR-4070
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B+ (tone B, technicalities S-) with a mid-centric signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $1700 (SR-4070)).
entries.quote: Surprisingly wide and spacious soundstage for a closed-back. Good low-end extension but rather shouty.

entries.name: ZMF Auteur
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B+ (tone A, technicalities B+) with a bright neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $1600).
entries.quote: Very pleasant tonality but lacking that last bit of definition for true top-tier status.

entries.name: HIFIMAN Ananda
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B+ (tone S-, technicalities B, ★ value) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $700).
entries.quote: One of the best tuned headphones available, only limited by its raw resolving ability.

entries.name: AKG K612 Pro
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B+ (tone S-, technicalities B, ★★★ value) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $200).
entries.quote: Basically dead-neutral tuning, emphasis on "dead". Strong all-rounder whose only fault is not having that "wow-factor".

entries.name: HIFIMAN Sundara
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B+ (tone A+, technicalities B, ★★ value) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $350).
entries.quote: Solid tuning with a little treble spiciness for the daring. One of the better midrange planars out there.

entries.name: Sennheiser HD 650
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B+ (tone A+, technicalities B, ★★★ value) with a warm neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $220 (HD6XX)).
entries.quote: The legendary neutral reference. "Veiled" with a warm tilt (in comparison to HD600), and pretty terrible at imaging.

entries.name: Fostex TH610
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B+ (tone B+, technicalities A-, ★ value) with a mild v-shape signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $600).
entries.quote: The most neutral of the Foster biodyna models. If you want a little more balance than the Teaks.

entries.name: E-Mu Teak
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B+ (tone B+, technicalities A-, ★ value) with a v-shaped signature (Semi-open Circumaural) (MSRP $400).
entries.quote: Excellent dynamics with one of the best bass I've heard in a headphone, though the midrange can be a little harsh.

entries.name: Sennheiser HD 800
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B+ (tone B-, technicalities S) with a bright neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $1700 (HD800S)).
entries.quote: Arguably the king of soundstage and raw detail, though at the cost of its infamous treble spike.

entries.name: Beyerdynamic T70
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B+ (tone A, technicalities B) with a bright neutral signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $600 (T70)).
entries.quote: Treble peak may offend some, but otherwise very well balanced and natural tonality with decent technicalities.

entries.name: MrSpeakers Ether C
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B+ (tone A, technicalities B) with a df-neutral signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $Discontinued 1500 (Replaced by Ether C Flow)).
entries.quote: Forward, in-your-face sound that's shouty and thin at the same time. A good reference for "true DF neutral".

entries.name: Shure SRH1540
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B+ (tone A, technicalities B, ★ value) with a neutral with bass boost signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $500).
entries.quote: Almost "Harman" tuning with some undesirable mid-bass bloat.

entries.name: AKG K702
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B+ (tone A, technicalities B, ★★ value) with a mid-centric signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $350).
entries.quote: Slightly more upper-mid-forward (read: shoutier) version of the K612.

entries.name: Stax SR-L500
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B+ (tone B-, technicalities S-) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $792+975 (SRM-353X)).
entries.quote: Generally pleasing tuning with a little honkiness in the centre-midrange.

entries.name: Shure SRH840
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B+ (tone A+, technicalities B-, ★★★ value) with a v-shaped signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $150).
entries.quote: Extremely well-executed V-shaped tuning with no erronous peaks or dips. More mid-bassy than sub-bassy.

entries.name: Stax SR-L300
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone B, technicalities A-) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $430+975 (SRM-353X)).
entries.quote: Generally pleasing tuning, though a little honky and fatiguing in the treble.

entries.name: ZMF Aeolus
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone B, technicalities A-) with a bright neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $1200).
entries.quote: Tonally, a vast improvement over the Aeolus with stock pads, bringing in extra clarity and bite.

entries.name: AKG K701
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone A-, technicalities B, ★ value) with a bright neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $450).
entries.quote: The brightest and arguably harshest of the K7-- lineup, but still very competent overall.

entries.name: HIFIMAN HE6se
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone B-, technicalities A) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $1100 (HE6se)).
entries.quote: Comes with an odd midrange dip. It's no HE6 replacement for sure.

entries.name: HIFIMAN HE560
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone B-, technicalities A) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $950 (HE560)).
entries.quote: Slight wonkiness around the lower midrange, but otherwise a capable planar headphone.

entries.name: Final D8000 Pro
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone B-, technicalities A) with a bright signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $4300).
entries.quote: Highly resolving headphone with solid imaging capabilities, limited by its somewhat wonky tonality.

entries.name: Final Audio D8000 Pro Edition
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone B-, technicalities A) with a bright signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $4000).
entries.quote: High treble-to-midrange contrast makes things sound shrill and borderline-sibilant.

entries.name: RAAL-requisite SR1a
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone B-, technicalities A) with a neutral signature (Earspeaker) (MSRP $4000 (Jotunheim R bundle)).
entries.quote: Weak, limp bass is the killing blow for what is an otherwise highly resolving and decently-tuned earspeaker.

entries.name: Sennheiser HD 560S
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone A, technicalities B-, ★ value) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $200).
entries.quote: Well-balanced tonality with good bass extension, just slightly hot in the upper-mids and treble.

entries.name: AKG K371
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone A, technicalities B-, ★★ value) with a harman signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $150).
entries.quote: Expectedly Harman tuning but lacks a bit of bite in the upper midrange for "true Harman".

entries.name: Focal Stellia
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone C+, technicalities S-) with a neutral with bass boost signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $3000).
entries.quote: "Harman-inspired" tuning works decently well, though a myriad of small quirks ultimately screws its tonal balance.

entries.name: Stax SR-L700
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone C+, technicalities S-) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $1570+975 (SRM-353X)).
entries.quote: Probably the most balanced tuning of the L-series, with the usual e-stat technicalities.

entries.name: ZMF Verite Closed
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone C+, technicalities S-) with a neutral with bass boost signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $2500).
entries.quote: Far more tonally balanced than its open counterpart, whilst retaining its reverberant staging.

entries.name: Audio-Technica ATH-ADX5000
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone C+, technicalities S-) with a bright neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $2000).
entries.quote: Clean, open sound reminsicent of the HD800, with a bit of midbass bloat and upper midrange shoutiness.

entries.name: STAX SR-L300 Limited
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone C+, technicalities S-) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $900+975 (SRM-353X)).
entries.quote: Honkier version of the standard L300.

entries.name: HIFIMAN Deva (wired)
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone S-, technicalities C+, ★ value) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $300).
entries.quote: Probably the most "mellow" of the Hifiman planars with the least resolving ability.

entries.name: Shure SRH440
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone S-, technicalities C+, ★★★ value) with a harman signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $100).
entries.quote: Closest thing to Harman thus far. Comes with a small upper treble spike and lacking raw resolution.

entries.name: Sony MDR-SA5000
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone B, technicalities B+) with a bass-rolled neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $400 (MDR-SA5000)).
entries.quote: Surprisingly competent for a decades-old set. Midrange is a little uneven but beats out many other modern TOTLs.

entries.name: HIFIMAN HE-5
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone B+, technicalities B) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $600 (HE5)).
entries.quote: The original Hifiman. Midrange is a little too scooped out but remains competitive even today.

entries.name: Denon AH-D5000
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone B, technicalities B+) with a v-shaped signature (Semi-open Circumaural) (MSRP $480 (AH-D5000)).
entries.quote: The usual "Foster biodyna dynamics" are at play here, with a somewhat fatiguing treble spike.

entries.name: Kennerton Odin
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone B+, technicalities B) with a warm neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $3600 (Bog Oak)).
entries.quote: Generally "okay" tonality with some odd dips here and there. Lacking serious extension for a planar.

entries.name: Kennerton Thror mk2
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone B+, technicalities B) with a warm neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $3600 (Bog Oak)).
entries.quote: Kind of a "nothing headphone"; not bad, not great, just good enough to be okay.

entries.name: Focal Radiance
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone B+, technicalities B) with a harman neutral signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $1300).
entries.quote: Probably the best of the closed-back Focals. Some tuning refinements over the Stellia, though technically limited.

entries.name: Sennheiser HD 660 S
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone B, technicalities B+, ★ value) with a warm neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $400).
entries.quote: An even darker HD6X0. A comparatively muffled mess just barely propped up by its decent resolving ability.

entries.name: Beyerdynamic DT 880
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone B+, technicalities B, ★ value) with a warm v-shape signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $350).
entries.quote: Certainly a "mini-HD800" in terms of tonality only, however still far inferior in technical ability.

entries.name: HarmonicDyne ZEUS
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone B+, technicalities B, ★ value) with a warm signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $350).
entries.quote: A rare combination of a warm-focused tonality with decent technicalities.

entries.name: Focal Clear Mg
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone B-, technicalities A-) with a warm neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $1500).
entries.quote: Lacks upper mids and resolution compared to its predecessor.

entries.name: Audeze LCD-XC
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone B-, technicalities A-) with a "balanced" signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $1300).
entries.quote: Definitely the least Audeze-sounding Audeze. A little quirky tonally, but nothing too offensive.

entries.name: Focal Elear
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone B-, technicalities A-) with a warm neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $1000).
entries.quote: Subdued upper midrange with the odd treble spike makes this a weird headphone to listen to.

entries.name: Sennheiser Momentum 3 Wireless
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone A-, technicalities B-, ★ value) with a u-shaped signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $350).
entries.quote: A massive improvement over its predecessor. Limited resolution and potentially intense tonality.

entries.name: Meze Empyrean
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone B, technicalities B) with a warm signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $3000).
entries.quote: Bland and unexciting tuning with compressed staging and generally underperforming technicalities.

entries.name: Beyerdynamic DT990 Pro (250Ω)
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone B, technicalities B, ★ value) with a v-shaped signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $200).
entries.quote: Pretty bog-standard V-shaped response with forward upper-midrange and decently high resolution.

entries.name: beyerdynamic TYGR 300R
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone B, technicalities B, ★ value) with a v-shaped signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $200).
entries.quote: Very reminiscent of the DT990.

entries.name: HIFIMAN HE400i (2020)
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B (tone B, technicalities B, ★★ value) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $170).
entries.quote: Well-executed reference-ish tuning with a slight treble emphasis.

entries.name: HIFIMAN HE-500
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B- (tone B+, technicalities B-) with a warm neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $900 (HE500)).
entries.quote: Perhaps the warmest of the Hifiman lineup. Not the most resolving.

entries.name: Sivga Phoenix
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B- (tone B+, technicalities B-, ★ value) with a warm neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $300).
entries.quote: A fairly competent warm-neutral monitor slightly held back by limited detail retrieval.

entries.name: Audeze LCD-24
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B- (tone C, technicalities S-) with a warm neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $3500).
entries.quote: A slight tonal improvement over the LCD-4, but also comes with a slight hit in resolution.

entries.name: Abyss Diana V2
entries.rawName: Abyss Diana Phi Abyss Diana V2
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B- (tone C, technicalities A+) with a warm signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $3000 (V2) 4000 (Phi)).
entries.quote: Needs a little more upper midrange to balance out the honkiness. Good dynamic performance especially in the bass.

entries.name: Audeze LCD-X (2021)
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B- (tone C, technicalities A+) with a warm neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $1200).
entries.quote: Tonally, a massive improvement over the previous version(s) though with the usual pitfalls of the Audeze house sound.

entries.name: Denon AH-D5200
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B- (tone B-, technicalities B) with a warm neutral signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $700).
entries.quote: Probably the least wonky of the new Denons. Suffers from some mid-bass bloat.

entries.name: Beyerdynamic DT1990 Pro
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B- (tone B-, technicalities B) with a warm v-shape signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $600).
entries.quote: An intense sound given its significant treble boost, but countered by a smooth lower-midrange bump.

entries.name: Audio-Technica ATH-M70x
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B- (tone B, technicalities B-, ★ value) with a neutral signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $300).
entries.quote: The most neutral of the M-series. Good tonality but still suffers from narrow imaging.

entries.name: Sennheiser HD25
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B- (tone B, technicalities B-, ★ value) with a u-shaped signature (Closed Supra-aural) (MSRP $200).
entries.quote: Punchy, energetic sound with decently balanced tonality. A pretty good beat-tracking monitor.

entries.name: Audeze LCD-GX
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B- (tone C, technicalities A) with a warm neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $900).
entries.quote: As a gaming headphone, possibly the best technically though with the usual pitfalls of the Audeze house sound.

entries.name: Audeze LCD-2 Closed Back
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B- (tone C, technicalities A) with a warm v-shape signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $900).
entries.quote: Not the worst Audeze in terms of tonality, but its tuning still doesn't live up to its technical capabilities.

entries.name: Audeze LCD-2 Classic
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B- (tone C, technicalities A) with a warm signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $800).
entries.quote: Classic Audeze combo of solid resolution with a confusing lack of upper midrange.

entries.name: BLON B20
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B- (tone A, technicalities C, ★ value) with a warm neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $450).
entries.quote: Basically a darker planar HD6X0, with equally closed-in staging and lacking the final resolving edge.

entries.name: Koss ESP95X
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B- (tone C, technicalities A, ★ value) with a mid-centric signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $450).
entries.quote: Good resolving ability and imaging, marred by its odd and honky midrange.

entries.name: Koss KSC75
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B- (tone A, technicalities C, ★★★ value) with a bass-rolled neutral signature (Open Clip-on) (MSRP $20).
entries.quote: Non-existent sub-bass and poor resolution. But it's so well-tuned you may not even care.

entries.name: Apple AirPods Max
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B- (tone B+, technicalities C+) with a u-shaped signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $550).
entries.quote: Great tonality, sub-focused bass emphasis, bassy without being muddy. Average imaging and resolution.

entries.name: ASTRO A40 TR
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B- (tone B+, technicalities C+, ★ value) with a warm v-shape signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $150).
entries.quote: Middling technicalities, but for a gaming headphone its tonality is surprisingly balanced.

entries.name: ZMF Verite
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B- (tone C-, technicalities S-) with a warm signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $2500).
entries.quote: Excellent resolution unfortunately marred by suppressed harmonics and a harsh upper-midrange.

entries.name: ES Lab ES-1a
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B- (tone C-, technicalities S-) with a bright neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $2050).
entries.quote: Seems inspired by the tuning of the SR-009 with some minor improvements, though not enough to call it "good".

entries.name: Audio-Technica ATH-M40x
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B- (tone A-, technicalities C, ★ value) with a neutral with bass boost signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $100).
entries.quote: Well-balanced tonality with disappointing detailing and claustrophobic imaging.

entries.name: Moondrop Void
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B- (tone A-, technicalities C, ★ value) with a warm neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $200).
entries.quote: Slightly midbass/lower-mid emphasised with good tonal balance, if rather "cheap"-sounding.

entries.name: Fostex TR80
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B- (tone A+, technicalities C-) with a neutral with bass boost signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $220 (TR80)).
entries.quote: A very well-tuned monitor-style headphone, if heavily bottlenecked by narrow imaging and blunt hits.

entries.name: E-Mu Walnut
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it B- (tone B-, technicalities B-, ★ value) with a "balanced" signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $100).
entries.quote: Tonality is somewhat off with peaks and dips here and there, but overall not a bad sounding headphone.

entries.name: Acoustic Research AR-H1
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone C+, technicalities B) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $600 (AR-H1)).
entries.quote: A tempered, almost bright-leaning planar (but not quite). Decent tonality and technical ability.

entries.name: Beyerdynamic T5p
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone C+, technicalities B) with a v-shaped signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $750 (T5P)).
entries.quote: Choppy midrange response is its biggest turnoff, but otherwise a decent V-shaped headphone.

entries.name: Timsok TS-1024
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone C+, technicalities B) with a warm v-shape signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $2000).
entries.quote: Somewhat warm midrange plagued with sharp and offensive treble.

entries.name: Sendy Aiva
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone B, technicalities C+) with a warm neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $600).
entries.quote: A slightly worse-tuned B20, kinda.

entries.name: AKG K712 PRO
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone C+, technicalities B) with a warm signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $500).
entries.quote: Sizeable mid-bass bloat that's barely reigned in by an equally sizeable upper-midrange emphasis.

entries.name: Sennheiser HD 599
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone B, technicalities C+, ★ value) with a v-shaped signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $200).
entries.quote: A little too sharp, a little too midbassy, but overall not the most offensive headphone out there.

entries.name: AKG K7XX
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone C+, technicalities B, ★ value) with a warm signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $200).
entries.quote: A more bloated-sounding K712.

entries.name: HarmonicDyne Helios
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone B, technicalities C+, ★ value) with a v-shaped signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $180).
entries.quote: Lack of bass extension is its biggest dealbreaker of what would be an otherwise solid headphone.

entries.name: Fostex TH7
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone B+, technicalities C) with a neutral signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $80 (TH7)).
entries.quote: Fairly neutral monitor-style headphone with poor imaging and detail retrieval.

entries.name: Sony MDR-Z1R
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone C, technicalities B+) with a v-shaped signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $1800).
entries.quote: Holes in the midrange. Big spike in the treble. Strangely disjointed soundstage. Decently resolving.

entries.name: Fostex TH900
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone C-, technicalities A) with a v-shaped signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $1600).
entries.quote: Spicy sibilance and bloated bass are disappointments in what is otherwise an extremely dynamic headphone.

entries.name: DCA Aeon 2 Closed
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone B+, technicalities C) with a u-shaped signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $900).
entries.quote: Passable tonality with dulled and blunted transients make for lacklustre detailing.

entries.name: Stax SR-009
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone D+, technicalities S+) with a bright neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $4325+975 (SRM-353X)).
entries.quote: Detail and resolution worthy of being called "the best", marred by the tonally-off midrange.

entries.name: Audeze LCD-4
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone D+, technicalities S) with a warm signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $4000+3000 (GS-X mk2)).
entries.quote: A classic example of a highly resolving yet wonky sounding headphone. Needs more upper midrange.

entries.name: Sony MDR-MA900
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone C+, technicalities B-) with a bass-rolled neutral signature (Earspeaker) (MSRP $200 (MDR-MA900)).
entries.quote: Imaging as expected of an earspeaker configuration; surprisingly good tonality and expected bad extension.

entries.name: Fostex TH909
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone C-, technicalities A-) with a v-shaped signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $1800).
entries.quote: A slightly more balanced TH900 with similar sibilance issues.

entries.name: Neumann NDH20
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone C+, technicalities B-) with a neutral with bass boost signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $500).
entries.quote: Feels like an attempt at Harman but ultimately missing the mark in the midrange tuning.

entries.name: 1MORE MK801
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone A-, technicalities C-, ★ value) with a neutral with bass boost signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $80).
entries.quote: Smooth, generally pleasing tonality throughout with no offensive characteristics.

entries.name: Rosson RAD-0
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone C, technicalities B) with a warm neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $2600).
entries.quote: Middling technicalities with suppressed upper midrange.

entries.name: Sony MDR-1AM2
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone B, technicalities C) with a warm u-shape signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $300).
entries.quote: Harman-ish tuning with a strong mid-bass presence and piercing upper treble response.

entries.name: Sennheiser HD579
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone B, technicalities C, ★ value) with a warm neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $200).
entries.quote: More or less a HD599 with slightly worse resolution.

entries.name: Abyss AB-1266
entries.rawName: Abyss AB-1266 Phi CC Abyss AB-1266 Phi
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone D+, technicalities A+) with a "balanced" signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $Replaced with TC).
entries.quote: Sinfully addictive bass and treble reponse, but the midrange tonality needs a lot of work.

entries.name: Audeze LCD-MX4
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone D+, technicalities A+) with a warm signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $3000).
entries.quote: Classic Audeze combo of solid resolution with a confusing lack of upper midrange.

entries.name: HIFIMAN HE-5
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone D+, technicalities A) with a v-shaped signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $700).
entries.quote: Strong contender for an excellent headphone, if not for the inexplicable hole in the mids.

entries.name: Sony MDR-CD380
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C+ (tone C+, technicalities C+) with a df-neutral signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $50 (MDR-CD380)).
entries.quote: Shouty and thin-sounding, though surprisingly competent imaging ability.

entries.name: Stax SR-X Mk2
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C, technicalities B-) with a bass-rolled neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $Discontinued).
entries.quote: Surprisingly good tonal balance marred by its complete absence of bass response.

entries.name: Audio-Technica ATH-A900X
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C, technicalities B-) with a warm with bass boost signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $Discontinued 300 (Replaced by A990Z)).
entries.quote: Subdued upper mids and enhanced mid-bass. If anything else, this is a headphone that wouldn't fatigue.

entries.name: Beyerdynamic DT860
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone B-, technicalities C) with a bright signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $Discontinued 250 (Replaced by DT880)).
entries.quote: Upwards-sloping bright and lean sound.

entries.name: Focal Celestee
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone B-, technicalities C) with a neutral with bass boost signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $1000 (Celestee)).
entries.quote: Thin and uneven mids with narrow, congested staging.

entries.name: AudioQuest NightHawk
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C, technicalities B-) with a warm bassy signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $600 (Nighthawk)).
entries.quote: Thick, grand, heavy... muddy.

entries.name: Audio Technica ATH-AWAS
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C, technicalities B-) with a mid-centric signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $1400).
entries.quote: Rolled off bass with somewhat suppressed treble. Not the worst but far from being tonally balanced.

entries.name: DCA Aeon 2 Noire
entries.rawName: DCA Aeon 2 Open DCA Aeon 2 Noire
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone B-, technicalities C) with a warm v-shape signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $900).
entries.quote: Arguably the best tuned DCA headphone with a slightly thick midrange and least offensive treble.

entries.name: beyerdynamic DT 1770 Pro MKII
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C, technicalities B-) with a u-shaped signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $600).
entries.quote: A slightly more balanced version of the old DT770.

entries.name: Bose QuietComfort 35 II (passive)
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone B-, technicalities C) with a v-shaped signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $350).
entries.quote: The typical mainstream V-shape response with middling technicalities.

entries.name: Harman Kardon FLY ANC
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone B-, technicalities C) with a neutral with bass boost signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $250).
entries.quote: Peaky, mid-bassy attempt at a Harman tuning.

entries.name: Koss SP540
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone B-, technicalities C) with a v-shaped signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $150).
entries.quote: The typical mainstream V-shape response with middling technicalities.

entries.name: Audio Technica ATH-AD1000X
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C-, technicalities B) with a "balanced" signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $500 (ATH-AD1000X)).
entries.quote: Quirky tuning with imbalanced upper harmonics. Similar to that of the AD2000.

entries.name: Audio-Technica ATH-AD2000X
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C-, technicalities B) with a "balanced" signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $750 (AD2000)).
entries.quote: Quirky tuning with imbalanced upper harmonics. Similar to that of the AD1000X.

entries.name: AKG K872
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C-, technicalities B) with a "balanced" signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $1500).
entries.quote: Strange pad shape makes for wildly-varying bass. Generally a tonally weird headphone.

entries.name: ZMF Atticus
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C-, technicalities B) with a bassy signature (Semi-open Circumaural) (MSRP $1100).
entries.quote: Bloated bass with wonky midrange, a killer combination.

entries.name: Sony MDR-Z7M2
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C-, technicalities B) with a u-shaped signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $900).
entries.quote: Sounds like a "Z1R-lite", with arguably better bass response but peakier treble.

entries.name: Audeze LCD-3
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone D, technicalities A+) with a mid-centric signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $1950).
entries.quote: Classic Audeze combo of solid resolution with a confusing lack of upper midrange. Now with extra honk.

entries.name: Audeze LCD-1
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone B+, technicalities D+) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $400).
entries.quote: The best tuned Audeze headphone with the worst resolution.

entries.name: Fostex TH500RP
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C, technicalities C+) with a "balanced" signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $700 (TH500)).
entries.quote: An interesting oldschool planar, vastly outpaced by today's market.

entries.name: Philips SHP9500
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C, technicalities C+) with a bright signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $Discontinued 80 (Replaced by SHP9600)).
entries.quote: Decent imaging chops held back by its intensely bright presentation and below-average resolution.

entries.name: DCA Ether C Flow 1.1
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C, technicalities C+) with a neutral with bass boost signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $1600).
entries.quote: Sounds like something went wrong with the upper-midrange tuning.

entries.name: Campfire Cascade
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C+, technicalities C) with a bassy signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $800).
entries.quote: Competent midrange tuning let down by a loose, bloated bass response.

entries.name: Grado The Hemp Headphone
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C, technicalities C+) with a bass-rolled neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $420).
entries.quote: Nothing much different from your average Grado; paid extra for the novelty, not the sonic improvements.

entries.name: Bose Noise Cancelling Headphones 700
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C+, technicalities C) with a neutral with bass boost signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $400).
entries.quote: More subdued presentation compared to its precedessor, almost to the point of being boring.

entries.name: Audeze Mobius (default preset)
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C, technicalities C+) with a warm neutral signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $300).
entries.quote: Not the total lack of upper midrange I expected, but a hole in the upper mids nonetheless.

entries.name: Grado GW100
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C, technicalities C+) with a "balanced" signature (Open Supra-aural) (MSRP $250).
entries.quote: Not the worst Grado, but you could still do better than Grado.

entries.name: Master & Dynamic MH40
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C, technicalities C+) with a bassy signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $250).
entries.quote: Too much bass, and not the good kind either.

entries.name: Beyerdynamic DT 770 Pro
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C, technicalities C+) with a u-shaped signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $160).
entries.quote: Sounds like a parody of Harman with its excessive 200Hz notch and overblown treble.

entries.name: AKG K240 Studio
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C, technicalities C+) with a mid-centric signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $70).
entries.quote: Abysmal bass extension with overly-boosted lower mids makes for a strange listening experience.

entries.name: Meze 99 Classics
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C-, technicalities B-) with a bassy signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $310).
entries.quote: Just excessive bass that unfortunately screws with the tonality of the mids.

entries.name: Audio Technica ATH-A2000X
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone D+, technicalities B) with a "balanced" signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $500 (ATH-A2000X)).
entries.quote: Somewhat mid-centric runing that's far too coloured for its own good.

entries.name: Denon AH-D9200
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone D+, technicalities B) with a mid-centric signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $1600).
entries.quote: Generally weird and wonky tuning that can also get rather harsh at times.

entries.name: ZMF Eikon
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone D+, technicalities B) with a bright signature (Semi-open Circumaural) (MSRP $1400).
entries.quote: Hole in the mids with a sharp piercing peak in the treble.

entries.name: Denon AH-D7200
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone D+, technicalities B) with a mid-centric signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $1000).
entries.quote: Generally weird and wonky tuning that can also get rather harsh at times.

entries.name: MrSpeakers Aeon Flow
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C, technicalities C) with a warm signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $Discontinued 800 (Replaced by Aeon 2)).
entries.quote: Reminds of the NightHawk a bit, except with far worse resolution.

entries.name: DCA Ether 2
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C, technicalities C) with a "balanced" signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $2300).
entries.quote: Hard to explain what exactly this sounds like, but the first thing you'd hear is probably the treble roll-off.

entries.name: DCA Ether Flow 1.1
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C, technicalities C) with a warm v-shape signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $1800).
entries.quote: Has elements of the DT880/HD800 tuning, with extra note thickness and more piercing treble.

entries.name: Audeze SINE DX
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C, technicalities C) with a mid-centric signature (Closed Supra-aural) (MSRP $600).
entries.quote: Decent bass extension, honky midrange presentation.

entries.name: B&W PX
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C, technicalities C) with a warm signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $400).
entries.quote: Warm, bloated sound with a largely muffled midrange.

entries.name: V-MODA Crossfade 2 Wireless
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C, technicalities C) with a v-shaped signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $330).
entries.quote: The typical mainstream V-shape response with middling technicalities.

entries.name: Audio-Technica ATH-MSR7b
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C, technicalities C) with a v-shaped signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $250).
entries.quote: Thin-sounding yet bloated at the same time. Intense upper midrange.

entries.name: Koss Porta Pro
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C (tone C, technicalities C) with a bass-rolled warm signature (Open Supra-aural) (MSRP $80).
entries.quote: The KSC75 is better.

entries.name: Stax SR-3
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C- (tone C+, technicalities C-) with a bass-rolled neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $500 (SR-3)).
entries.quote: Similarly tuned to the SR-X, albeit with a much more blunted presentation.

entries.name: Audio Technica ATH-A1000Z
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C- (tone C-, technicalities C+) with a neutral with bass boost signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $400 (ATH-1000Z)).
entries.quote: Odd upper-midrange tuning results in a scratchy, uneven presentation.

entries.name: Audio-Technica ATH-A2000Z
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C- (tone C-, technicalities C+) with a neutral with bass boost signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $650 (ATH-A2000Z)).
entries.quote: Odd upper-midrange tuning results in a scratchy, uneven presentation.

entries.name: Audeze LCD-X
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C- (tone D-, technicalities A+) with a neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $1700).
entries.quote: Probably the worst tuned Audeze available. At least, this specific unit is.

entries.name: Audio-Technica ATH-M50x
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C- (tone C+, technicalities C-) with a neutral with bass boost signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $150).
entries.quote: The headphone that the elites love to hate... isn't that bad. An alright starter headphone, if generally overrated.

entries.name: Grado SR60
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C- (tone C-, technicalities C+) with a bright neutral signature (Open Supra-aural) (MSRP $80 (SR60e)).
entries.quote: Forward, almost nasally midrange with an intense treble response.

entries.name: Sony MDR-V6
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C- (tone B+, technicalities D) with a df-neutral with bass boost signature (Closed Supra-aural) (MSRP $Discontinued 200 (Replaced by M1ST)).
entries.quote: Somewhat thin-sound and shouty but overall a very well-tuned set, if extremely blunted and narrow in imaging.

entries.name: AKG K812
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C- (tone D+, technicalities B-) with a bright signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $1500).
entries.quote: Sharp, shrill, piercing, sibilant, and all other synonyms.

entries.name: Focal Elegia
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C- (tone D+, technicalities B-) with a neutral with bass boost signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $900).
entries.quote: Severe lack of upper midrange and treble results in a muffled, dulled tone.

entries.name: DCA Voce
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C- (tone D-, technicalities A) with a "balanced" signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $3300).
entries.quote: Wonky, honky, whatever you want to call it. Probably the worst e-stat I've heard.

entries.name: Oppo PM3
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C- (tone B, technicalities D) with a v-shaped signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $500 (PM-3)).
entries.quote: Fairly well-tuned, if very technically limited in both resolution and imaging performance.

entries.name: QUAD Era-1
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C- (tone D, technicalities B) with a mid-centric signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $800).
entries.quote: Kind of a "nothing headphone"; not the worst thing in the world but no praises either.

entries.name: Stax SR-40 Electret SR4 Adapter
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C- (tone C-, technicalities C) with a bass-rolled neutral signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $Discontinued).
entries.quote: One of the few Stax electrets out there. Not great in tonality nor technical performance.

entries.name: Shure AONIC 50
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C- (tone C-, technicalities C) with a v-shaped signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $400).
entries.quote: A parody of the V-shaped response. Scooped mids, hollow sound.

entries.name: Precide Ergo 2
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C- (tone C-, technicalities C) with a bass-rolled neutral signature (Earspeaker) (MSRP $250).
entries.quote: Sounds exactly like what it is: a headphone with a broken seal.

entries.name: Audio Technica ATH-M30X
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C- (tone C, technicalities C-) with a neutral with bass boost signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $70).
entries.quote: Scooped upper midrange with below average technicalities.

entries.name: Logitech G Pro X
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C- (tone C+, technicalities D+) with a bassy signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $130).
entries.quote: Too much bloat going on in the bass, which is a shame given that the rest of the mids are alright.

entries.name: Sony MDR-CD900ST
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C- (tone B-, technicalities D) with a warm neutral signature (Closed Supra-aural) (MSRP $Discontinued 200 (Replaced by M1ST)).
entries.quote: Solid dark-ish reference tuning, with the usual V6/7506-esque absence of soundstage.

entries.name: Stax SR-84
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C- (tone B-, technicalities D) with a bass-rolled neutral signature (Open Supra-aural) (MSRP $500 (SR-84)).
entries.quote: Surprisingly coherent tuning for what is effectively an unsealed electret. Lacks too much resolution.

entries.name: Audio Technica ATH-L5000
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C- (tone D, technicalities B-) with a "balanced" signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $4000).
entries.quote: Quirkiness not unexpected of an Audio Technica; arguably their worst closed-back. Sure took an L on this one.

entries.name: Audio-Technica ATH-AWKT
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C- (tone D, technicalities B-) with a bright signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $1900).
entries.quote: AWKT, more like AWKward... I'll leave now.

entries.name: Koss PRO DJ 100
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C- (tone B-, technicalities D) with a df-neutral with bass boost signature (Closed Supra-aural) (MSRP $80).
entries.quote: Good tuning but unfortunately weird pad shape that makes it hard to get the proper bass response.

entries.name: Sony WH-1000XM4
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it C- (tone C-, technicalities C-) with a bassy signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $350).
entries.quote: Consumer-friendly heavy bass unfortunately bleeds into the mids, but otherwise fine.

entries.name: Pioneer Monitor 10 II
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D+ (tone D+, technicalities C) with a "balanced" signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $150 (Monitor 10)).
entries.quote: Slightly honky midrange, weird uneven treble, and hard to get a proper seal.

entries.name: Klipsch HP3
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D+ (tone D+, technicalities C) with a warm v-shape signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $1200).
entries.quote: Lots of bass bloat, way too thick-sounding and lacking definition.

entries.name: Beyerdynamic Amiron Home
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D+ (tone D+, technicalities C) with a warm v-shape signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $750).
entries.quote: Mid-bass bloated and shouty at the same time.

entries.name: Logitech G933s
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D+ (tone C, technicalities D+) with a bassy signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $200).
entries.quote: Too much bloat going on in the bass, which is a shame given that the rest of the mids are alright.

entries.name: Pioneer SE-Master1
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D+ (tone D, technicalities C+) with a bright signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $2500).
entries.quote: Treble daggers applied directly into ear.

entries.name: Beyerdynamic T5 (3rd Gen)
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D+ (tone D, technicalities C+) with a bassy signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $1000).
entries.quote: Wibbly-wobbly midrange with far too liberal a bass boost makes for a terrible sound.

entries.name: Drop + THX Panda
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D+ (tone B-, technicalities D-) with a warm signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $400).
entries.quote: Well-tuned but with overpowering mid-bass and extremely dulled transients.

entries.name: Sennheiser HD 559
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D+ (tone D+, technicalities C-) with a warm signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $150).
entries.quote: Big, thick sound that muffles everything but the most surface level details.

entries.name: Sony MDR-7510
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D+ (tone C, technicalities D) with a neutral with bass boost signature (Closed Supra-aural) (MSRP $130 (MDR-7510)).
entries.quote: Everything just sounds strange and oddly sharp in tone, but extremely blunted in transients.

entries.name: iBasso SR1
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D+ (tone D, technicalities C) with a "balanced" signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $500).
entries.quote: Wonky midrange is one thing, but dying after 6kHz is another.

entries.name: Audio-Technica ATH-AD900
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D+ (tone D, technicalities C) with a "balanced" signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $300).
entries.quote: Extremely uneven tuning, mediocre resolution, not a great choice unless you only want a wide soundstage.

entries.name: Audio Technica ATH-A990Z
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D+ (tone D, technicalities C) with a v-shaped signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $220).
entries.quote: Odd cup resonance results in wonky imaging. Prefer the original A900X.

entries.name: Beyerdynamic DT 250 (250 Ohm)
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D+ (tone C, technicalities D) with a mid-centric signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $200).
entries.quote: Horrible treble extension and a honkiness that gets worse the longer you listen.

entries.name: V-MODA Crossfade LP2
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D+ (tone D, technicalities C) with a bassy signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $200).
entries.quote: Big bass, bad bass, no treble extension.

entries.name: Beyerdynamic DT 1350
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D (tone D, technicalities C-) with a warm signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $500 (DT1350)).
entries.quote: Muffled, narrow-sounding, and lacking surface-level detail.

entries.name: Logitech G431
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D (tone C-, technicalities D) with a warm signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $Discontinued 130 (Replaced by G432)).
entries.quote: Bloated bass like the rest, but further exacerbated by the recessed midrange.

entries.name: Sennheiser Amperior
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D (tone D, technicalities C-) with a mid-centric signature (Closed Supra-aural) (MSRP $300 (Amperior)).
entries.quote: Extremely nasally vocals and lacks weight in the mids.

entries.name: B&O BeoPlay H7
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D (tone D, technicalities C-) with a "balanced" signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $450).
entries.quote: Wonky, honky midrange. Not great.

entries.name: Audio-Technica ATH-AD700X
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D (tone D, technicalities C-) with a warm signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $200).
entries.quote: Extremely uneven tuning, mediocre resolution, not a great choice unless you only want a wide soundstage.

entries.name: Audio-Technica ATH-AD500X
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D (tone D, technicalities C-) with a warm signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $170).
entries.quote: Suppressed and uneven upper-mids, mediocre resolution, not a great choice unless you only want a wide soundstage.

entries.name: iBasso SR2
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D (tone D-, technicalities C) with a bright signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $550).
entries.quote: Shouty, shrill and lacking the proper heft in the bass region.

entries.name: Koss Pro4S
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D (tone D-, technicalities C) with a v-shaped signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $150).
entries.quote: Horrible lower-midrange scoop screws with every instrument.

entries.name: Audio Technica ATH-EW9
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D (tone D+, technicalities D) with a mid-centric signature (Open Clip-on) (MSRP $330).
entries.quote: Forget shout; this thing screams.

entries.name: Focal Listen Professional
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D (tone D, technicalities D) with a "balanced" signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $300).
entries.quote: Not sure if this is supposed to seal, but in the event that it isn't: why?

entries.name: Sennheiser HD 4
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D (tone D, technicalities D) with a "balanced" signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $70).
entries.quote: At least it's not the Momentum 2.0 Wireless.

entries.name: Yamaha HP-50S
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D- (tone D+, technicalities D-) with a warm signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $60 (HP-50S)).
entries.quote: Bloated, lacking resolution, narrow imaging. Just a bad headphone all around.

entries.name: AudioQuest NightOwl
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D- (tone D-, technicalities D+) with a dark signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $700 (Nightowl)).
entries.quote: Heavily downsloped response makes the upper harmonics completely disappear.

entries.name: Shure SRH240
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it D- (tone D+, technicalities D-) with a v-shaped signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $60).
entries.quote: Compressed, honky and lacking all but the most surface-level of detailing.

entries.name: Sennheiser HD 820
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it E (tone E, technicalities B) with a v-shaped signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $2400).
entries.quote: The mystical acoustic properties of Gorilla Glass could not save this monstrosity.

entries.name: Beyerdynamic T1 (3rd Gen)
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it E (tone E, technicalities B-) with a warm v-shape signature (Open Circumaural) (MSRP $1000).
entries.quote: When you answer "yes" to the question "how much lower mids do you want?"

entries.name: Sennheiser Momentum 2.0 (wireless)
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it E (tone E, technicalities C+) with a unique signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $180).
entries.quote: Probably the worst headphone Sennheiser has ever made. Yes, even the HD820.

entries.name: Final Sonorous VIII
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it E (tone E, technicalities C) with a unique signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $3000 (Sonorous VIII)).
entries.quote: Quirky artisanal Japanese handiwork so quirky that they forgot that it's supposed to play music.

entries.name: Final Sonorous X
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it E (tone E, technicalities C) with a unique signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $5000 (Sonorous X)).
entries.quote: Quirky artisanal Japanese handiwork so quirky that they forgot that it's supposed to play music.

entries.name: Spirit Torino Radiante
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it E (tone E, technicalities C) with a unique signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $2250).
entries.quote: Humps for days. Wouldn't be a stretch to call this "ꟿ-shaped".

entries.name: AKG K92
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it E (tone E, technicalities D) with a v-shaped signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $60).
entries.quote: Hole in the bass, hole in the mids, hole in the treble. AKG's struck a turkey.

entries.name: AKG K72
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it E (tone E, technicalities D) with a v-shaped signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $50).
entries.quote: Hole in the bass, hole in the mids, hole in the treble. AKG's struck a turkey.

entries.name: AKG K52
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it E (tone E, technicalities D) with a v-shaped signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $35).
entries.quote: Hole in the bass, hole in the mids, hole in the treble. AKG's struck a turkey.

entries.name: FiiO EH3
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it E (tone E, technicalities E) with a bassy signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $200).
entries.quote: Sounds as if the ANC is trying to cancel out its own sound.

entries.name: EKSA E900 Pro
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it E (tone E, technicalities E) with a dark signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $50).
entries.quote: Typical cheaply-made headphone that's all bass with zero technical ability. A waste of any money.

entries.name: Yamaha HP3
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it F (tone F, technicalities F) with a complete failure signature (Semi-open Circumaural) (MSRP $Discontinued).
entries.quote: Virtually no records of this exist on the internet, and maybe it's better that way.

entries.name: Pioneer SE-2P
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it F (tone F, technicalities F) with a complete failure signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $20 (SE-2P)).
entries.quote: The pads look like toilet plungers. Sounds like one too.

entries.name: Sansui SS100
entries.verdict: Crinacle ranks it F (tone F, technicalities F) with a complete failure signature (Closed Circumaural) (MSRP $340 (SS-10)).
entries.quote: A simulation of how it's like to have hearing damage.
